description: Reference guide for Garmin workout JSON structure

step_types.ExecutableStepDTO: Regular workout step (warmup, interval, cooldown, recovery, rest)
step_types.RepeatGroupDTO: Repeat group containing nested steps with numberOfIterations. Give it stepType 6 (repeat) and endCondition 7 (iterations) with endConditionValue equal to numberOfIterations.

stepOrder: One depth-first counter over the whole workout (1, 2, 3, ...). A RepeatGroupDTO takes the next number and its nested steps continue the count from there (group 2, children 3 and 4, next top-level step 5). Never restart at 1 inside a group.

3.description: Work/effort interval (use for exercises in strength workouts)

5.description: Complete rest (use for rest between sets in strength workouts)

6.description: Repeat group step type (used internally by RepeatGroupDTO)

1.description: Manual lap press (use for warmup/cooldown in strength workouts)

7.description: Number of iterations (used internally by RepeatGroupDTO)

10.description: Number of repetitions (use for strength exercises)

2.description: Cycling power zone 1-7 (use zoneNumber; based on FTP %), or a custom % FTP range (targetValueOne/targetValueTwo as percentages with targetValueUnit {"unitKey": "percent"}). Do NOT use for absolute watt targets.

4.description: Heart rate zone (use zoneNumber 1-5 for named zones, or targetValueOne/targetValueTwo for custom bpm range)

6 (running/swim).description: Pace zone for running or swimming (use zoneNumber, or step-level targetValueOne/targetValueTwo in m/s for a custom range)

6 (cycling).description: Cycling absolute watt range (use targetValueOne=low_watts, targetValueTwo=high_watts). Use this instead of power.zone when targeting specific watts, NOT zone numbers.

strength_training_fields.description: Additional fields for strength training workout steps (ExecutableStepDTO)
strength_training_fields.category: Exercise category (e.g., BENCH_PRESS, PULL_UP, CURL, SHOULDER_PRESS, ROW, SQUAT, DEADLIFT, TRICEPS_EXTENSION, PLANK, LUNGE, CARDIO)
strength_training_fields.exerciseName: Specific exercise name (e.g., BARBELL_BENCH_PRESS, PULL_UP, DUMBBELL_BICEPS_CURL, DUMBBELL_SHOULDER_PRESS, BENT_OVER_ROW_WITH_DUMBELL, BODY_WEIGHT_DIP)
